units.source_text: 大竹七段早有打算，下完这盘棋之前，得有三个月不能回家，他兴冲冲地来了。

en.t: From the start, Otake 7-dan had made up his mind that he would not be able to go home for three months until this game was finished, and he had come full of enthusiasm.

units.source_text: 这下子，他不仅感到扫兴，而且觉得细则规定改变了。

en.t: Now he not only felt disappointed, but also felt that the detailed rules had been changed.

units.source_text: 究竟有没有把这些规定通知名人，就无从知晓了。

en.t: There was no way to know whether these rules had actually been communicated to the Meijin.

units.source_text: 再说，这次对局制定了严格的规则，可是从一开头就不遵守规则，使七段对往后的事深感不安。

en.t: Besides, strict rules had been set for this match, but they were not being followed from the very beginning, which made the 7-dan deeply uneasy about what would happen later.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，没有向名人交代清楚，这确实是工作人员的过错。

en.t: In any case, failing to explain things clearly to the Meijin was indeed the staff's fault.

units.source_text: 也许七段看到名人特殊，没人敢向他陈述苦衷，因自己年轻，别人反而来说服自己，以便收拾局面。

en.t: Perhaps the 7-dan saw that the Meijin was treated as special, that no one dared tell him their difficulties, and that because he himself was young, the others had instead come to persuade him in order to settle the situation.
